purpose: Pre-specify the separate deterministic provenance audit required by Protocol 2.5 for RQ1 evidence traceability before any FORMAL003 structural output is inspected.

scientific_role.inference: descriptive deterministic audit; no new significance test

timing.input_becomes_available: after the single immutable FORMAL003 M1 canonical artifact is built and validated
execution_order: freeze immutable FORMAL003 M1 structural/canonical artifacts
run the pre-canonical privacy audit at its frozen boundary
run remaining pre-specified structural consistency/observability diagnostics

entity_universe.erp_system: excluded from the structural-entity denominator because the canonical ERPSystem model does not declare per-entity source_refs
entity_universe.evidence: audited separately as provenance records, not counted as subject structural entities

source_artifact_registry: source_artifacts and source_artifact_hashes must contain the same keys
every source_artifact_hashes value must be a 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest
entity_source_refs: every structural entity in the frozen universe must declare at least one source_ref
every declared source_ref must resolve in both source_artifacts and source_artifact_hashes
declared_evidence_ids: evidence_ids are optional for canonical entity types whose builder intentionally represents provenance only through source_refs
when an entity declares evidence_ids, every declared ID must resolve to a canonical evidence record
evidence_records: every evidence record must resolve its artifact_path basename to the frozen source-artifact registry
every evidence artifact_hash must be a valid 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hex digest
every structural_json evidence artifact_hash must exactly equal the corresponding source_artifact_hashes value
network_trace evidence is allowed to hash the sanitized per-screen observation subset while source_artifact_hashes stores the full network-evidence container hash
every evidence source_entity_type/source_entity_id pair must resolve to an entity in the frozen structural universe

primary_traceability_metric.name: entity_source_traceability
primary_traceability_metric.numerator: structural entities with at least one source_ref and with all declared source_refs resolved in the frozen source-artifact registry
primary_traceability_metric.denominator: all structural entities in the frozen audit universe

failure_rule: A failed traceability audit is preserved and blocks structural HITL/publication for that FORMAL003 attempt. Do not repair the formal artifact or change this contract after observing the failed formal result.
